decision: REVISE — kernel freshness_check subprocess is wired and detects drift (TP 1.0) with noise tolerance (FP 0.0) at reduced N, but frozen SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST does not hold per spec: orthogonality NOT demonstrated (Phase B degenerate, producer pooled A+B+C to manufacture variance yielding anti-correlation r=-0.53, one-sided TOST passes but two-sided fails), variance gate C3 artifact, missing parallel-channel baselines, and trivial regression; audit REVISE, producer_claim_supported=false

claim_updates.reason: C-FRESHNESS remains EXPERIMENTAL. This kernel integration demonstrates existence of the HTTP freshness pipeline (real HTTP GET to mechanism.freshness.probe_url with Bearer token, behavioral 0.8 on 401/403 vs 0.0 on 200, TP 1.0 on 45 samples 3 drifts x3 endpoints x5 at threshold 0.25, FP 0.0 on 60 noise-only samples, ~1ms localhost latency, 3/3 existing kernel tests pass). However audit REVISE with producer_claim_supported=false bounds the ceiling: orthogonality at delta=0.15 NOT demonstrated per frozen measurement_validity #3/decision_rule C4 — spec-required Phase B (8 co-occurring conditions) has behavioral variance zero (constant 0.8, nan correlation) so producer computed pooled r=-0.5346 CI [-0.612,-0.466] on COMBINED A+B+C (n=225) which is anti-correlated not orthogonal (one-sided CI_upper -0.466 <0.15 passes but two-sided CI [-0.622,-0.434] outside [-0.15,0.15], p_lower ~1.0, shared variance 28% vs allowed 2.25%); variance gate C3 per spec fails (0/3 beh in Phase B only vs reported 3/3 combined); parallel-channel justification vs B-BEHAVIORAL-ONLY/B-STRUCTURAL-ONLY not measured; regression gate trivial (no probe_url); sample size N=5 vs prereg N=20; structural spec-code mismatch (X-Request-Id required but kernel uses md5(etag|cache_control) only); transport failure returns STALE 0.5. Prior orthogonality confirmations at delta=0.15 on stochastic localhost mock remain established (EXP-GRAPH-35353011131 r=0.046 CI_upper0.135, EXP-GRAPH-35389145821 r=0.002 CI_upper0.092, EXP-PRODUCT-35445596342 r=-0.026 CI_upper0.064, all audit PASS, n=480) but this experiment does not extend that ceiling nor justify PRODUCT_CORE. No promotion.

product_action: No promotion to PRODUCT_CORE. Kernel freshness_check code remains in src/spider/kernel.py at bounded localhost mock ceiling only. Require re-run at prereg N=20 per cell with non-degenerate Phase B, two-sided equivalence |r|<0.15, missing baselines, staleness-gating regression, and transport-failure handling before bounded product advancement. Do not ship.
next_question: Does the kernel freshness gate at prereg N=20 per cell with a non-degenerate co-occurring design (including no-drift controls or graded drift severity to provide behavioral variance) maintain TP>=0.85, FP<=0.10, two-sided orthogonality |r|<0.15 at delta=0.15, and demonstrate parallel-channel advantage over behavioral-only and structural-only baselines with staleness-gating regression and correct transport-failure handling?
reason: Producer reported SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST with all six frozen conditions PASS (C1 TP 1.0, C2 FP 0.0, C3 3/3 variance, C4 r=-0.53 CI_upper -0.466 TOST p_upper 3.99e-29 PASS, C5 3/3 tests, C6 0.99ms). Audit REVISE finds recomputed C1_TP 1.0 and C2_FP 0.0 match producer but at N=60/45 vs prereg 240/180 (N=5 vs 20 per cell, disclosed), C3 and C4 are artifacts of pooling A+B+C to manufacture variance because Phase B behavioral is degenerate constant 0.8 (std~1e-16, r=nan); spec-literal Phase B would be MEASUREMENT_INVALID/FALSIFIED, not PASS. One-sided equivalence is insufficient: large negative r fails two-sided |r|<0.15 (Fisher CI [-0.622,-0.434], p_lower~1.0). Missing baselines B-BEHAVIORAL-ONLY and B-STRUCTURAL-ONLY prevent parallel-channel justification; regression trivial; latency localhost-only; structural X-Request-Id mismatch; RequestException->STALE confound. Therefore SURVIVES is not justified at spec; maximum justified ceiling is drift detection+noise tolerance+latency at reduced N on localhost Flask 3.1.3 HS256 mock. Orthogonality at delta=0.15 remains established only from three prior stochastic-mock PASS experiments, not from this wiring. No VALIDATED or PRODUCT_CORE advancement warranted.
